description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Category', which handles category axes in a graphing library, including label management, dataset application, and axis rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Category
classes.description: A class for handling category axes with label management and dataset application in a graphing library.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Category
methods.description: Constructor initializing the category axis with default label interval.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the axis, always 0.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the axis, based on the number of labels.

methods.name: _setMinimum
methods.description: Placeholder for setting minimum, not applicable for this axis type.

methods.name: _setMaximum
methods.description: Placeholder for setting maximum, not applicable for this axis type.

methods.name: forceMinimum
methods.description: No-op; minimum cannot be forced on this axis type.

methods.name: forceMaximum
methods.description: No-op; maximum cannot be forced on this axis type.

methods.name: setLabelInterval
methods.description: Sets label interval, accepting array, 'auto', or rounded numeric value.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Preprocesses a value for logarithmic axes, returning label if found.

methods.name: _minorLabelInterval
methods.description: Always returns false; minor labels are disabled.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Calculates size of the axis in pixels, including labels and title.

methods.name: _applyDataset
methods.description: Applies dataset to axis, ordering labels based on dataset points.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Returns pixel distance between adjacent labels.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the next label point based on label interval.

methods.name: _isNumeric
methods.description: Returns false; axis is categorical, not numeric.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the axis, including axis lines and tick marks.
